page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries mixing Hebrew/Aramaic/Syriac script with Latin glosses; running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes or footnotes.

main_text.p: אכליתא, אכליות Ch. Clamor, rugitus, vociferatio.
ܦܠܛܘܪܐ Syr. Accusator, calumniator. Sic synec-dochicè vocatur Diabolus. Plur. ܩܛܪܝܢ.
ܦܠܛܘܝܐ Syr. Delatio, accusatio, ad Rom.1.30. Sed Johan. 18.29. scribitur ut duæ distinctæ voces ܦܠܛܘܐ, quod apparet ex ל finali.
אוכלוםא, אוכלום Ch. ܐܟܠܘܣܐ Syr. Populus, Coetus, turba, congregatio. Græc. ὄχλος. Act. 21.24. scribitur ܐܟܠܘܣܐ. Plur. אוכלוסין.
אכמא, אכם Niger, Atratus, Pullatus. Fœmin. אכמתא Nigra, Levit.11.19. in Jon.
אוכמא, אוכם Ch. & Syr. Idem. חמרא אוכמא Vinum nigrum, id est, rubrum, Esth.1.9. in Targ.sec. Plural. אוכמין. Fœm. אוכמתא. Sic Syr. Matth.5.36.
אוכמות Idem, יומי אוכמות עער הבלו Dies nigredinis crinium, id est, juventutis, vanitas, Eccl.11.10.
אכסדרא Ch. Procæton, Prætorium, Atrium, Græcum est ἐξέδρα. Hinc forte numero plurali legendum אכסנדריא pro אכסנדריא Esth. 7. 10. in Targum sec.
אכסן Ch. ܐܟܣܢܐ Syr. Hospes, peregrinus. Ex Græco ξένος. Plur.Chald. אכסנין, אכסניא: Syr. ܐܟܣܢܐ.
ܐܟܣܢܐ Amans hospites, φιλόξενος, Hospitalis. Vide quoque כסן.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are rendered approximately; the Syriac and Greek glyphs in several entries are not reliably legible and may differ from the printed forms. Entries are transcribed as read.
